quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

obligation.description: leave the intersection right of the centerline of the highway entered

timing.description: after entry, at first full-body destination exit
